source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

address: 155 Myers Corners Rd. Wappingers Falls, NY 12590

reading.body:
NYM7 publishes 3 MW of IT capacity across 100,000 square feet of technical space. At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, 3 MW supports roughly 300 racks; at 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, the same 3 MW supports roughly 75 racks. Neither figure is the operator's claim. The site is small by the standards of purpose-built AI infrastructure, where individual GPU clusters routinely consume tens of megawatts.

The single published certification is SSAE 16 Type II, which qualifies the facility to host workloads requiring audited controls over financial and operational reporting processes. No other certifications are published on the spec page.

This site has read operator spec pages for 31 mapped New York facilities, and NYM7 is the only one that publishes a megawatt figure, making it rank first in the state by published IT capacity with a published-state total of 3 MW. That ranking reflects the absence of published data from the other 30 facilities, not a demonstrated scale advantage. Most mapped facilities in New York publish no capacity figure at all, so the true distribution of capacity in the state is not visible from published specs alone.
